name: B10-0086/2025 (ECR) – Systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to cancel the death sentences of Kurdish activists Pakhshan Azizi and Verisheh Moradi, and of everyone else on death row. It condemns Iran's repression of women, minorities and dissidents, and its arrests of European Union citizens on vague charges. It asks the European Union to set up a team to help detained Europeans and their families, and to treat Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organisation. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and does not itself change any law.

- Iran is asked to cancel the death sentences and release detained European Union citizens.
- The European Union is asked to create a task force on hostages and label Iran's Revolutionary Guard as terrorist.
- The resolution is sent to Iran's parliament and government; no law changes directly.
